opening.argument: Consider the instructional purpose and the warnings presented alongside the trading demonstrations. The speaker explains how to use CoinSwitch for spot and derivatives trading, including platform features and initiating trades, while the description covers market and limit orders. Although the video shows leverage levels and explains how leverage can multiply profit, it expressly presents the example as teaching and advises viewers to use less leverage and smaller positions while learning. The surrounding risk disclosures state that crypto products and NFTs are unregulated, highly risky, and may offer no regulatory recourse for losses. The visible leverage screen likewise warns of high risk and liquidation. Taken together, these facts establish an educational and cautionary walkthrough of trading interfaces and controls, not a promise of assured returns or an unqualified invitation to trade.
